title: New date: registration opens on 3 November
text: We apologise, but the opening of registration has to move a little. Registration for POCUS 2027 now opens on Tuesday 3 November 2026. Everything else stays the same, and we look forward to welcoming you in Gothenburg.

title: All course information is now online
text: You can now find all information about POCUS 2027 under the tab POCUS 2027 in the menu: practical details, the programme, registration and more information.

title: Registration for POCUS 2027 opens on 3 November
text: We are happy to announce that registration for Neonatal Hemodynamics & POCUS 2027 in Gothenburg, 31 May – 3 June 2027, opens on 3 November 2026. This year the course grows to four days, with GI ultrasound and NEC as a new focus, and Prof. Alan Daneman from SickKids, Toronto joins our international faculty. Early bird prices apply until 28 February 2027, and places are limited.
